benefit_text: The scheme pays Rs.300/- per month to disabled people between 18 and 79 years. The scheme pays Rs.500/- per month to disabled people aged 80 years and above.
who_can_apply: People aged 18 years and above can apply. Applicants are residents of India with disability more than 80%. Applicants belong to Below Poverty Line and dwarfs are also included.
documents: Papers needed are BPL Card and Aadhaar card and disability certificate. Age proof and passport size photographs are also needed.
how_to_apply: People apply online through UMANG App and search for NSAP. People fill basic details and choose mode of payment of pension. People upload photo and submit the form.
